title: Orbweaver topic
description: One orbweaver topic file (`assets/books/<book>/topics/<name>.yaml`): a page or pages of typed blocks. If a file validates against this schema the app parses and renders it. Unknown keys are errors because the renderer silently ignores them.

topic.description: A topic: one or more pages of blocks.

id.description: Logical id, kebab-case, unique across all books; the target of `topic:<id>` links.

list_subtitle.description: Subtitle shown under the title in the contents list.

last_reviewed.description: Source version string (e.g. `pocketbook v1.7`), not a date.

aliases.description: Alternative names, weighted like tags in search.

layout.description: `scroll` = one continuous column; `paged` = each page snaps to one screen.

font_family.description: Body typeface; must be a font the app bundles (`RobotoCondensed`).

pages.description: Pages, each with its own `page_number` and `blocks` (preferred form).

blocks.description: Blocks of a single-page topic (legacy form; use `pages` instead).

palette.description: Palette overrides, role → colour. Cascades book → chapter → topic → block; any role may be overridden and custom roles added. Common roles: accent, accent_fill, accent_branch, alert, alert_fill, alert_text, severity_{mild,moderate,severe}_{header,tile}, provider_{emt,aemt,intermediate,paramedic,critical_care,any}, pop_{adult,peds}, warning_{safety,caution}, flow_{decision,entry,convergence}, cc_link_{fill,border}, note_{fill,border,text}, danger_text.

age_band.description: One age row of a banded entry node.

value.description: Threshold for that age, e.g. `90 mmHg`.

cc.description: Optional Critical-Care value shown in a fused lavender column (needs `cc_title` on the node).

flow_node.description: A flowchart node: entry, decision, or a continuation step.

bands.description: Age-tiered thresholds drawn as a striped mini-table inside the node.

cc_title.description: Header of the fused Critical-Care column when `bands` carry `cc` values, e.g. `Or MAP`.

provider_level.description: Minimum provider level cleared for the intervention (WVEMS badge): E = EMT, A = AEMT, I = Intermediate, P = Paramedic, P(CC) or CC = Critical Care. Omit for any level.

peds_only.description: Pink `Peds` side tab on the right edge of the tile.

warning.description: Side warning callout flanking a node.

type.description: `safety` = red octagon on the left (scene safety, BSI); `caution` = purple trapezoid on the right (capacity, refusal, Critical-Care cross-reference). Only the first of each type renders.

convergence_bullet.description: A bullet inside a convergence node.

link_id.description: Visual cross-reference cue (underline); the app does not navigate on it.

convergence_exit.description: A labelled arrow leaving the convergence node.

loopback.description: `id` of a branch to loop back to. Omit for a forward arrow into `post_convergence`.

convergence.description: The node where branches reconverge (or a post-convergence box).

cc_link.description: Lavender Critical-Care reference pill under the convergence.

text.description: Pill text, e.g. `Sepsis`; may carry a `[text](topic:…)` link.

dose_row.description: One row of the dose reference strip under a flowchart.

population.description: Who the dose is for; drives the row stripe (adult grey, peds pink).

branch_continuation.description: Downstream chain under one branch (asymmetric flow).

entry_arrow_label.description: Label on the arrow from the branch's last action into the first node, e.g. `Every 2 minutes`.

nodes.description: Nodes rendered downward under this branch only.

branch.description: One branch of a severity flowchart.

id.description: Branch id; the target of a convergence `loopback`.

severity.description: WHO IMCI tint: emergency = pink, priority = yellow, non_urgent = green.

continues.description: Render label + down arrow only: the branch flows straight into the next block of the topic.

linear_step.description: A step in a linear flowchart: `type: content` = a titled box with bullets; otherwise an action tile (same fields as an action).

provider_level.description: Minimum provider level cleared for the intervention (WVEMS badge): E = EMT, A = AEMT, I = Intermediate, P = Paramedic, P(CC) or CC = Critical Care. Omit for any level.

differential_card.description: One referential card in a differential grid.

cascade_step.description: One yes/no step of a cascade; `continuation` is the next step.

decision.description: Yes/no question shown as the step header.

action_answer.description: Which answer triggers `action`; the other answer continues.

algo_table.description: Compact bordered table rendered inside an algorithm box.

align.description: Per-column alignment; default left for column 0, centre for the rest.

algo_box.description: A content box: an outcome's result, a shared named box, or the terminal.

severity.description: WHO IMCI tint: emergency = pink, priority = yellow, non_urgent = green.

algo_outcome.description: One labelled outcome of a decision stage.

label.description: Outcome label on the arrow, e.g. `Yes`, `< 7 days`.

goto.description: `id` of a shared box in `boxes` to jump to (instead of an inline `box`).

continue.description: After this outcome the flow rejoins the spine and proceeds to the next stage; otherwise the outcome is a terminal leaf.

algo_stage.description: A decision stage on the vertical spine.

cycle_branch.description: A side box off a cycle node, optionally looping back.

label.description: Arrow label from the node to this box.

side.description: Which side of the spine the box sits on.

loop_to.description: `id` of a spine node to draw a return arrow to (the loop). Omit for a terminal side action.

loop_label.description: Annotation on the return arrow, e.g. `reassess q5–10 min`.

cycle_node.description: One node on the spine of a cycle flowchart.

severity.description: WHO IMCI tint: emergency = pink, priority = yellow, non_urgent = green.

down_label.description: Label on the arrow to the next spine node, e.g. `once stable`.

flowchart_severity.description: Entry → decision → parallel branches → convergence (the WVEMS/ProtocolBook default).

anchor.description: Slug that makes this block a link target: `[text](#slug)` in this topic, or `topic:<id>#slug` from another topic.

entry_chain.description: Sequential nodes before the fork, top to bottom.

entry.description: Single entry node (shorthand for a one-node `entry_chain`; do not use both).

pre_decision_actions.description: Action tiles between the entry chain and the decision.

decision.description: Optional explicit decision node before the branches.

post_convergence.description: One more box below the convergence, reached by a forward exit arrow.

dose_table.description: Medication dose strip at the bottom.

warnings.description: Side callouts flanking the first entry node.

flowchart_linear.description: Single column: entry → step → step → convergence. No decision, no branches.

entry.description: Single entry node (shorthand for a one-node `entry_chain`; do not use both).

post_convergence.description: One more box below the convergence, reached by a forward exit arrow.

dose_table.description: Medication dose strip at the bottom.

warnings.description: Side callouts flanking the first entry node.

flowchart_differential.description: Decision into a grid of referential cards (no action tiles per card).

entry.description: Single entry node (shorthand for a one-node `entry_chain`; do not use both).

pre_decision_actions.description: Action tiles between the entry chain and the decision.

decision.description: Decision diamond above the card grid, e.g. `Location?`.

post_convergence.description: One more box below the convergence, reached by a forward exit arrow.

dose_table.description: Medication dose strip at the bottom.

warnings.description: Side callouts flanking the first entry node.

flowchart_cascade.description: Linear yes/no chain (e.g. a contraindication checklist).

anchor.description: Slug that makes this block a link target: `[text](#slug)` in this topic, or `topic:<id>#slug` from another topic.

terminal_action.description: Action taken if every step falls through.

action_width.description: Fraction of the width given to the action column.

flowchart_algorithm.description: Vertical multi-decision algorithm: stages with labelled outcomes; loops are `goto` references, not drawn arrows.

anchor.description: Slug that makes this block a link target: `[text](#slug)` in this topic, or `topic:<id>#slug` from another topic.

terminal.description: Final box at the bottom of the spine.

flowchart_cycle.description: Cyclic algorithm: a spine whose side boxes can loop back to a node by `id` (drawn as a return arrow).

anchor.description: Slug that makes this block a link target: `[text](#slug)` in this topic, or `topic:<id>#slug` from another topic.

flowchart.description: A flowchart in one of six variants, chosen by `variant` (default `severity`).

table_cell.description: A cell: a string (single line; a string containing newlines renders as markdown), a list of strings (bullets), or an object for span/markdown control.

span.description: Number of columns this cell covers.

cells.description: Cells left to right; omit for a banner-only row.

title.description: Row banner rendered above the cells.

header.description: Row label in a left header column.

group.description: Group label; contiguous rows with the same group collapse under one label.

severity.description: WHO IMCI tint: emergency = pink, priority = yellow, non_urgent = green.

table.description: Columns + rows with optional severity tinting.

columns.description: Column headers; empty list = no header row.

column_widths.description: Per-column fixed widths in px, for `layout: scroll`.

column_tint.description: Per-column background tint; empty string = none.

column_bar.description: Per-column in-cell magnitude bars for numeric cells.

zebra.description: Alternate row shading (where a row has no severity tint).

sticky_header.description: Pin the header row while the body scrolls (scroll layout).

sticky_first_column.description: Pin the first column while the body scrolls horizontally (scroll layout).

lookup.description: Show a go-to-row finder keyed on the first column.

lookup_label.description: Label for the finder field; default `Go to <first column>`.

max_height.description: Max height in px; the table scrolls inside it.

layout.description: `standard` = dense grid; `boxed` = each cell a rounded tile (flow-grid rows); `scroll` = fixed column widths, horizontal scroll.

flex.description: Share of the parent row/column width (12-column convention: a row's children should sum to 12). Only meaningful inside a `row` or `column`.

anchor.description: Slug that makes this block a link target: `[text](#slug)` in this topic, or `topic:<id>#slug` from another topic.

prose.description: Markdown text. Most content lives here.

markdown.description: Markdown: `**bold**`, `- ` bullets, and links `[text](topic:<id>)`, `[text](topic:<id>#<anchor>)`, `[text](#<anchor>)` or an https URL. Provider badges `{E}` `{A}` `{I}` `{P}` `{P(CC)}` `{}`.

callout.description: Attention card (amber by default) with the title as a chip.

dashed.description: Dashed outline for a `callout` (the print's conditional box).

boxed.description: Rounded-border centred tile, for use as a grid cell in a `row`.

text_scale.description: Body size as a fraction of the normal prose size (e.g. 0.8 for references).

call_er.description: Pair this box with the print's `Call ER` tile on its right.

critical_care_link.description: Lavender Critical-Care tab fused under this box (WVEMS).

flex.description: Share of the parent row/column width (12-column convention: a row's children should sum to 12). Only meaningful inside a `row` or `column`.

anchor.description: Slug that makes this block a link target: `[text](#slug)` in this topic, or `topic:<id>#slug` from another topic.

band_callout.description: Markdown tinted to say who it applies to (WVEMS population/credential bands).

band.description: `peds` = pink Pediatrics band; `critical_care` = lavender Critical Care band.

markdown.description: Markdown: `**bold**`, `- ` bullets, and links `[text](topic:<id>)`, `[text](topic:<id>#<anchor>)`, `[text](#<anchor>)` or an https URL. Provider badges `{E}` `{A}` `{I}` `{P}` `{P(CC)}` `{}`.

title.description: Section label inside the band; omit for the band's default (`Pediatrics` / `Critical Care`); empty string for a bare band.

drug_dose.description: One dose line of a drug card.

population.description: Who the dose is for; drives the row stripe (adult grey, peds pink).

name.description: Drug name; also its default anchor slug.

image.description: Asset path of a product shot, e.g. `assets/books/<book>/images/x.png`.

anchor.description: Slug that makes this block a link target: `[text](#slug)` in this topic, or `topic:<id>#slug` from another topic.

procedure_card.description: How-to procedure card: scope-badged header over numbered steps.

name.description: Procedure name; also its default anchor slug.

scope.description: Minimum provider level cleared for the intervention (WVEMS badge): E = EMT, A = AEMT, I = Intermediate, P = Paramedic, P(CC) or CC = Critical Care. Omit for any level.

steps.description: Step lines. Prefix syntax: plain = next numbered step; `@2a text` = explicit label; `- text` = sub-bullet; `~[E] text` = scope note; `[E]` on a step = inline scope chip; leading `:` = dashed emphasis; leading `!` = pink peds band; leading `^` = lavender Critical-Care band; `NOTE: text` = full-width note.

blocks.description: Children side by side; their `flex` values should sum to 12.

flex.description: Share of the parent row/column width (12-column convention: a row's children should sum to 12). Only meaningful inside a `row` or `column`.

column.description: Vertical layout of child blocks (inside a `row` slot).

blocks.description: Children stacked vertically; an empty list is a blank spacer cell.

flex.description: Share of the parent row/column width (12-column convention: a row's children should sum to 12). Only meaningful inside a `row` or `column`.

arrows.description: Down or right arrows bridging rows of a flow grid.

inline.description: Label beside the arrow instead of above it.

flex.description: Share of the parent row/column width (12-column convention: a row's children should sum to 12). Only meaningful inside a `row` or `column`.

sources.description: Column indices of the top arrows.

target_center.description: Column index (fractional allowed) of the merged arrow.

conversion_dose.description: A discrete strength tagged with its tier (tiers mode).

route.description: Route, when the same agent has several (e.g. `PO`, `IV`).

unit.description: Dose unit override for this agent.

mode.description: `equivalence` = free numeric entry with factors to a reference; `tiers` = pick from fixed strengths grouped in tiers.

reference_label.description: Short label for the reference line, e.g. `MME`.

source.description: Where the factors/tiers come from (shown; required for clinical safety).

tiers.description: Ordered tier names low → high (tiers mode).

excluded.description: Agents deliberately not auto-converted, with the reason.

formula_option.description: A select option: a bare value, or `{value, label}`.

formula_input.description: One input field of a formula calculator.

optional.description: Does not block computation when blank.

formula.description: Numbers in → number out, via a built-in formula.

kind.description: Which built-in formula computes the result. The math is compiled into the app; a YAML author cannot add kinds.

score_option.description: One option of a choice/scale item.

type.description: `toggle` = yes/no worth `points`; `choice` = pick one option (chips); `scale` = pick one level (stepper).

points.description: Points when a toggle is on.

score_band.description: A total-score interval and its interpretation.

block.description: One vertical section of a page, chosen by `type`.

page.description: One page of a topic (maps to one source page).

page_number.description: Printed page number of the source; shown in the header badge and page-break divider.
